name: kn-property-tax-stamp-duty
description: Saint Kitts and Nevis property taxes for 2026: annual property tax in St Kitts (Cap. 20.32; IRD residential example: value less EC$80,000 at 0.2%, due 30 June 2026, now in SMARTS) and in Nevis (Cap. 6.13(N); 0.2% replaced 0.156% from 1 January 2025, payment deadline extended to 30 September 2026 during the revaluation, 30 days to object), and stamp duty on land transfers under the Stamps Act, Cap. 20.40 (10% paid by the vendor on the higher of consideration and value, 12% of market value in Special Development Areas and the South East Peninsula, 6% on gifts, EC$100 between spouses and parents and children), with the alien landholding licence and form S-10. Trigger phrases include St Kitts property tax, Nevis property tax 2026, stamp duty St Kitts, vendor stamp duty 10%, buying property St Kitts.
